text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I spot an Umamusume by
the school gate, seemingly
looking around
for something.

Oh... Thank you for asking. Your words
ride upon such a gentle
breeze. By chance,
would you know where to find a healing
wind?

A healing wind. There was a rather violent
gust, you see, and poor
little Daruma got
shaken about like a petal in a spring
shower.

So that's why I've been trying to find a
lighter, refreshing current, but
I'm afraid
I've not been having much luck.

Ah, I suppose that's only to be
expected—inevitable as the monsoons of
early summer.
I'm quite sorry to have taken
up your time, then.

I'm afraid my search is somewhat pressing,
so I must be away. Thank
you again for
your concern, stranger of the soft breeze.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um, you don't have to think too hard
about it. Yamanin Zephyr is
kinda always
like that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's a bit weird, but she probably wasn't
trying to confuse you. It's
more like she
just doesn't try to make sense...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she does her own thing, so don't
waste too much energy trying
to figure her
out, or you'll just fry your brain.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a sympathetic look, the onlooking
pair continue on their way, leaving me to
wonder what I could have done. There's at
least one
thing I understood...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...How are you doing, Daruma? Just hang
in there a little longer for
me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You're... the one with the gentle breeze
from before. Don't tell me
you whooshed
along after me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My... To think that such a soft breath of
wind was enough to fill your
sails. I
appreciate your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She bends down, looking at the base of a
tree. Following her gaze, I
spot a thrush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While it looks like a regular old bird,
maybe this is the "poor little
Daruma" she
was talking about? It looks a bit
battered...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that I was.
I had hoped to find a calm
wind for the poor thing to rest its weary
wings, but there aren't any around right
now. I've been torn between looking east
or south for some fresher air.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not sure how much of the wind
talk is literal, but I'm getting
the gist: she's
trying to find shelter for the shaken
thrush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We bring the battered bird inside and give
it a look-over. Fortunately, nothing seems
broken—it's just a little rattled from the

strong winds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I really can't thank you enough.
Although...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This room...
It looks like we've taken over
some trainer's office. Do
you think they'll
mind that we've borrowed it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh! I didn't realize.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer badge? Ah, is that what those are?
I suppose that would
explain why I've been
seeing them around.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I simply thought it was some trend in
circulation. It's not uncommon
for fashion
currents to sweep through the city.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
But that aside,
I'd like to share something
with you as thanks for all you've done for
little Daruma. Would you accompany me a
spell?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She takes my hand in hers and walks me
out into the hall and
beyond...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Whew... What a lovely evening breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This rooftop is the best place on campus
to enjoy the winds. It's
especially nice at
dusk this time of year—so cool and
refreshing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The hot,
still air is swept out by the light
chill of night... like nature's
offering us
refreshments. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's like wind chimes to my ears.
I'm glad to hear you enjoy it
as much as I
do.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I like to come up here when air pressure
weighs my mind down. It never fails to get
me feeling like a leaf, dancing happily in
the
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm? But you've been responding to me
normally this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You came and helped after I told you
about Daruma, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A guilty twinge hits me. With the cryptic
way she described the
situation, I didn't
know about the bird until I saw it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I just...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! So you weren't following a word
of my rambling, and yet you
still came out
to aid me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... You're quite the peculiar
character. But it seems my senses
were
right about you being a gentle breeze at
heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I am so very grateful for what you did for
Daruma today. And I would be most
delighted to demonstrate my running, if
you would come to see it sometime. But
for now, farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This Yamanin Zephyr was like a breeze of
wind herself: a gentle and
airy free spirit,
meandering through the conversation as
she pleased.
